decision.explanation: The question asks for the artist associated with the song "With a Little Help from My Friends." The Beatles are directly identified as the creators of the song in D1S1. Joe Cocker is cited as the artist of an album bearing the same name in D4S1, and Lu Elliott is similarly cited for another album with the same title in D7S5. Each refers to a distinct artistic work with the same title, supporting the legitimacy of multiple answers.
